SSS01.name: 时砂小鱼
SSS01.form: a small spindle-shaped body with soft bevelled edges, a blunt conical head, a small terminal mouth, a gently curved lateral line, a short slender caudal peduncle
SSS01.fins: a short dorsal fin set far back, a rounded tail fin, small rounded pectoral fins
SSS01.markings: faint concentric rings along the flanks
SSS01.colour: 沙金半透明底、乳白年轮纹

SSS02.name: 溯流鲑
SSS02.form: an elongated fusiform body with a slightly arched back, a pointed snout, a terminal mouth, the lower jaw slightly hooked, cycloid scales, a straight complete lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS02.fins: a short-based dorsal fin, a small fleshy adipose fin, a slightly forked tail fin, pointed pectoral fins
SSS02.markings: a line of short vertical dashes along the flank

SSS03.name: 零度蝶鱼
SSS03.form: a deep diamond-shaped laterally compressed body with crisp bevelled edges, a small pointed head, a short tubular snout, a small mouth, a continuous dorsal profile, a short compressed caudal peduncle
SSS03.fins: a long dorsal fin joined to the anal fin by a thin membrane, a rounded tail fin, fan-shaped pectoral fins
SSS03.markings: two narrow vertical bands crossing the flanks, a single band through the eye

SSS04.name: 昨日鲈
SSS04.form: a stout oval body with a straight upper profile, a large head, a slightly concave forehead, a wide terminal mouth, the lower jaw projecting slightly, ctenoid scales, a gently arched lateral line
SSS04.fins: a dorsal fin with a deep notch between the spiny and soft parts, a slightly concave tail fin, fan-shaped pectoral fins
SSS04.markings: a faint horizontal band along the middle of the flank, scattered marks on the gill cover

SSS05.name: 遗迹鳉
SSS05.form: a small cylindrical body with a flat-topped head, a short blunt snout, an upturned small mouth, an eroded scalloped edge to the gill cover, cycloid scales, a gently curved lateral line
SSS05.fins: a long continuous dorsal fin with a rounded outline, a rounded tail fin, small rounded pectoral fins
SSS05.markings: a row of short vertical notches along the upper flank

SSS06.name: 虚时鲳
SSS06.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with smooth bevelled edges, a small blunt head, a short snout, a small terminal mouth, the upper jaw slightly longer than the lower, a slender compressed caudal peduncle
SSS06.fins: a long dorsal fin, a matching long anal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, long slender pectoral fins
SSS06.markings: a faint vertical shadow band behind the gill cover

SSS07.name: 刹那鲴
SSS07.form: an elongated slightly compressed body with a gently convex back, a conical head, a short blunt snout, a small inferior mouth with a thin lower lip, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line, a long caudal peduncle
SSS07.fins: a short dorsal fin with a smooth outline, a deeply forked tail fin, long pointed pectoral fins
SSS07.markings: a row of small paired spots along the lateral line

SSS08.name: 须臾鲹
SSS08.form: a fusiform slender body with a rounded belly, a pointed conical head, a small terminal mouth, the upper jaw slightly longer than the lower, small cycloid scales, a slightly curved lateral line, a narrow compressed caudal peduncle
SSS08.fins: a long dorsal fin with a low anterior lobe, a deeply forked tail fin, long sickle-shaped pectoral fins
SSS08.markings: a row of small scutes along the caudal peduncle, short diagonal stripes on the upper flank

SSS09.name: 瞬息鳉
SSS09.form: a small slender cylindrical body with a flattened dorsal profile, a rounded head, a short blunt snout, an upturned small mouth, cycloid scales, a gently curved lateral line, a slender caudal peduncle
SSS09.fins: a long dorsal fin set far back, a rounded tail fin, small rounded pectoral fins
SSS09.markings: a row of tiny irregular flecks along the flank
SSS09.colour: 浅琥珀半透明、瞬息白闪

SSS10.name: 一刻鲹
SSS10.form: a moderately elongated fusiform body with a slightly arched back, a pointed snout, a small terminal mouth, small cycloid scales, a curved lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS10.fins: a long dorsal fin with a pointed anterior lobe, a deeply forked tail fin, long pointed pectoral fins
SSS10.markings: a single short vertical tick band behind the head
